title: Chapter 312: Specialized Ghost-Killing Force
content:
Chapter 312: Specialized Ghost-Killing Force

"Launch an indiscriminate attack!"

After receiving Wu Qing's order to attack indiscriminately, the five-star and six-star Zerg troops on standby in the lord's protection area immediately launched an attack on the eight-clawed weird.

The attack of the five-star Zerg Sky Guard and the five-star Zerg Devourer turned the eight-clawed weird and the Zerg puppies mixed with them into light and disappeared.

For the six-star Zerg Queen, parasitic control is invalid. The weird is not a normal creature, and the parasitic spores cannot control them.

Spawning is a rule-level attack, which is definitely effective. The limited number of six-star queens' spawning attacks should be reserved for stronger weirds.

Only the trapping net can be used. The huge trapping net of the six-star Zerg Queen restrains a large number of eight-clawed weirds like a net for fish.

The plague of the six-star Zerg Scorpion was released, and the state of the eight-clawed weirds infected by the plague spores was immediately affected, even those eight-clawed weirds with spiritual ideology were no exception.

The eight-clawed weirds infected by the plague can be fought by Zerg puppies.

One hundred six-star Zerg Mammoths were dropped under those black blocks to meet the arrival of the Octopus.

Any attack of the Octopus was ineffective against the six-star Zerg Mammoths, and the six-star Zerg Mammoths cut the Octopus easily with a casual blow, just like a sharp kitchen knife cutting a fish.

The six-star Mammoths charged and killed all the Octopus along the way.

The main combat arms of the Zerg army participated in the battle and suppressed the offensive of the Octopus that suddenly appeared.

The Octopus, whose average strength was close to three stars, suffered heavy casualties under the attack of the Zerg main combat forces.

Especially those Octopus infected by the plague of the six-star Zerg scorpion and the mucus attack of the five-star Zerg Devourer, were quickly weakened to the point where they were easily killed by the Zerg puppies.

The Zerg puppies no longer sent reinforcements. Many Zerg puppies that had escaped from the weirdness began to retreat to the lord's protection area of the ancient desert. It was useless to drill underground, as there were all kinds of weirdness underground.

Facing a large number of powerful eight-clawed weirdness, the number of Zerg puppies was no longer important. There was no need to send a large number of Zerg puppies out to bear the damage of the Zerg main combat arms.

The black blocks hanging in the air kept pouring out eight-clawed weirdness, and from time to time there would be huge and powerful eight-clawed weirdness drilling out.

The Zerg army relied on the lord's protection of the ancient desert and fought against the eight-clawed weirdness with full firepower.

As time went on, the number of Zerg puppies outside the lord's protection area became fewer and fewer. They either retreated or were killed by the eight-clawed weirdness that was not infected.

Ten seven-star Zerg scorpions and ten seven-star Zerg queens began to take action, because eight-clawed weirdness equivalent to seven-star strength appeared from time to time, and the Zerg did not need to hold back.

Weirdos are powerful beings lurking in the dark. With the Queen watching, Wu Qing has nothing to worry about. Just kill as much as you want.

Try to eliminate as many weirdos as possible before dawn to see how the world rules will react after the battle ends.

The plague area created by the seven-star Zerg scorpion is huge. A large number of Zerg puppies happily rush into the plague area and attack the eight-clawed weirdos infected by the plague.

Slowly, except for the plague areas created by 110 six-star and seven-star scorpions, the Zerg puppies have disappeared from other areas.

The Zerg army gradually uses the plague areas created by Zerg scorpions, the firepower coverage of Zerg Devourers and Zerg Sky Guards, and the mental attacks of Zerg hosts to block the areas where the black blocks are located. As soon as the eight-clawed weirdos appear, they will be hit hard.

The Zerg Queen assists, uses trapping nets to assist in control, and uses eggs to kill the seven-star eight-clawed weirdos.

Zerg mammoths and Zerg puppies assist in the attack on the ground.

The Zerg army fought all night long around the black blocks that suddenly appeared.

...

The sky was getting white, and the sun was about to appear.

Those irregular black blocks that looked like space channels disappeared silently.

Even those eight-clawed monsters that had not been killed in time gradually faded and disappeared soon.

"The space rules of this world are quite interesting!"

That night, Wu Qing and the Queen of Zerg had been studying those black blocks and had some understanding of the space rules of this world.

The battle between the Zerg army and the monsters finally ended, and the world rule reward that Wu Qing had been expecting arrived as expected.

It was still a large amount of luck and the relaxation of the world rules on the strength of the Zerg members. The amount of rewards was equivalent to the Zerg's occupation of the ancient desert territory.

"This weird is indeed a third-party force, also eroding this world!"

"This makes it much easier, no need to worry about finding a suitable enemy!"

"Queen of the Worm, based on the information collected from the battle with the weird last night, optimize the deployment of troops dedicated to fighting the weird!"

"The ten air forces here, make up for the losses, and all transfer to the battlefield to attack the territory of the evil god camp, and continue to increase the pressure on the evil god camp!"

Wu Qing said to the Queen of the Worm.

After the battle with the weird last night, the Zerg army found that the force configuration of the Zerg air force suitable for dealing with the army of the evil god camp was not suitable for fighting the weird.

The Zerg puppy and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpion did not play a big role.

Wu Qing has decided that in addition to attacking the evil god camp, he must also fight the weird at the same time to speed up the progress of the Zerg in obtaining the status of a major clan.

This requires more efficient combat troops to fight against special enemies such as the weird.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading the exciting content!

As for the ten Zerg air forces that have been idle, Wu Qing did not disband their formation, but sent them all to the battlefield where the Zerg was vigorously attacking the evil god camp.

In order to force the evil god camp to send a strong army to fight, the Zerg needs to continue to put pressure on the evil god camp.

The ten Zerg air forces flew back to the Zerg third sub-base in the ancient desert territory, and were teleported to the Zerg second sub-base through the high-star pupa channel in the base.

After replenishing some of the Zerg flying dragons lost in the battle with the weird last night, the ten Zerg air forces flew eastward along the endless mountains, following the Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions that were constantly flying eastward on the ground, and entered the territory of the evil god camp.

With their participation in the war, the speed of sweeping the territories of various races in the evil god camp will be greatly increased.

…

Wu Qing plans to continue the battle between the Zerg and the weird in the safer ancient desert territory.

The various forces in the local camp did not know that while the Zerg were fighting everywhere, they also opened up a strange battlefield that they could not even imagine.

The normal local camp race army and the evil god camp army, fighting against the weirdness in this world, it would be like an egg hitting a rock.

The battle that the Zerg army encountered last night, even the army of the super tribe could not withstand.

The weirdness that the Zerg army encountered in the front was not bad, and the army of this world could still fight it at the cost of a big loss.

The eight-clawed weirdness that came out later was huge in number, with an average strength of three stars, various forms, and unpredictable attack methods. There were also powerful weirdness lurking behind them, and seven-star weirdness kept appearing. Even if the most elite alien human army came to fight, there was no chance of winning.

Only the Zerg, an alternative, could fight against the weirdness in this world.

…

The Queen of Zerg has come up with a series of troop deployment plans for the Zerg troops fighting against the weirdness. Wu Qing took a look and found that they were all good, so he chose a plan he liked.

In the third Zerg sub-base in the ancient desert territory, a large number of Zerg main combat troops began to hatch.

Because there is no default unspoken rule for fighting with the weird. The weird will be of any strength, and it will not be taken into consideration at all.

If it were not for the suppression of the Queen of Zerg, the powerful weird lurking in the dark would definitely deal with the Zerg army personally.

Therefore, there is nothing to take into consideration when the Zerg fights with the weird, and the seven-star troops can be used at will.

Wu Qing is still looking forward to the appearance of eight-star weirds. As long as ten eight-star weirds are killed, the Zerg mother nest can be upgraded to eight-star immediately.

Wu Qing discovered that the Zerg came to this world, except for the slow development in the early stage, the faster it developed, and even the Zerg mother nest was upgraded twice.

Judging from the situation of the Zerg army fighting with the weird last night, it is not surprising that eight-star weirds appeared.

Seven-star troops, at this stage, only a few special Zerg troops have been upgraded to this strength, and the cost-effectiveness is the highest.

For Zerg Sky Guard, Zerg Devourer, Zerg Destroyer, Zerg Hydralisk and other Zerg main arms with large forces, upgrading to five stars is basically enough. Upgrading further is a bit wasteful in the face of various enemies now.

The main task of these Zerg arms is to kill the enemy's main forces on a large scale. The strongest enemy's main forces are only about three stars on average. Five-star Zerg arms are basically enough to deal with these enemies.

If they are assisted by other arms, their killing efficiency will be even higher, so there is no need to upgrade to a higher star strength.

In the future, when facing stronger enemies, some Zerg main arms with large forces can appropriately upgrade some of their forces to increase their strength to six stars.

The seven-star arms of the Zerg are still the Zerg Scorpion, Zerg Queen and Zerg Mammoth. If necessary, other Zerg arms can be upgraded to seven stars in small quantities.

The Zerg Scorpion's Destruction, Plague and Black Bee are all powerful rule-level abilities. After their strength is increased to seven stars, these three abilities are even more terrifying.

In the battle with Weird last night, Wu Qing chose the attacking Plague instead of the defensive Black Bee because of the limited number of Zerg scorpions.

If the number of Zerg scorpions was sufficient, and a layer of Black Bee defense was added to the Zerg army, the Zerg army might not have to hide in the lord's protection range when fighting Weird.
